title: The Salt of the Weeping Wood
premise: Paloma Okonkwo, a runaway apprentice who has survived by knowing every smuggler's path through the Thornfell mountains, is the first to see the border wards collapse on the night the stars go out. Hunted by both the crown's wardens and the smugglers he betrayed to escape, he discovers the king has been hollowed and replaced by a salt-born entity from the Weeping Wood, an ancient forest that feeds on grief. To save the realm, Paloma must ally with the warden sworn to arrest him, descend into the Wood's drowned heart, and unbind the true king — but doing so requires surrendering his own hidden name, the last thing keeping him invisible. In the end, Paloma trades his anonymity for truth: the king is restored, the stars relight, and Paloma, no longer a ghost, stands trial for his crimes and chooses loyalty over escape.
about_author: L. M. Ashgrove is the pen name of a former cartographer who spent a decade mapping mountain passes before turning to fiction. They write fantasy rooted in borders, exile, and the quiet violence of small loyalties.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Guiding a smuggler caravan through Thornfell, Paloma feels the border wards snap like cut harp strings as every star vanishes overhead. He abandons the caravan to run alone, choosing invisibility over warning anyone. Emotional beat: the cold comfort of self-preservation curdling into dread.

chapters.title: What the Warden Carried
chapters.summary: Warden Ilsa Vane's POV. Ilsa crosses the dead wards into Thornfell carrying a royal writ and her brother's unsent letter, hunting the apprentice who once mended her patrol's charms. She finds the abandoned caravan, its people salt-crusted and silent. Emotional beat: duty sharpening into personal obsession.

chapters.title: Salt on the Doorstep
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Reaching his old master's cottage, Paloma finds hedge-witch Maren gone and the doorway crusted with weeping salt that whispers names. Among Maren's effects he finds a page naming the Weeping Wood as the source of the blight. Emotional beat: grief for the home he fled, guilt for having fled it.

chapters.title: The Price of Old Debts
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. His former smuggling crew corners him in a ravine; their leader, Doss, wants blood for the betrayal that got two of them hanged. Paloma buys his life by revealing a hidden pass — spending knowledge he can never reclaim. Emotional beat: the cost of survival measured in secrets.

chapters.title: A Crown of Quiet
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. Summoned to the capital, Ilsa attends court and notices the king speaks only in borrowed phrases, his shadow moving a half-beat late. The queen begs Ilsa privately to investigate without warrant. Emotional beat: the vertigo of realizing the law itself may be compromised.

chapters.title: The Map That Lies
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Following Maren's notes, Paloma finds her maps altered — routes redrawn toward the Weeping Wood, annotated in a hand that isn't hers. He realizes she went into the Wood deliberately and left the trail for him. Emotional beat: anger at being manipulated softening into trust.

chapters.title: Two Thieves on One Road
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Ilsa ambushes Paloma on the salt road; instead of arresting him, she proposes an uneasy bargain — his knowledge of the Wood for her silence about his crimes. Neither trusts the other. Emotional beat: wary, prickly alliance born of mutual need.

chapters.title: The Village That Forgot Itself
chapters.summary: Shared POV alternating. They pass through Harrowmere, where villagers have forgotten their own children, their memories replaced with salt-white stillness. A dying grandmother mistakes Paloma for her son. Emotional beat: horror at what forgetting costs, foreshadowing Paloma's own hidden name.

chapters.title: Lessons in Unbinding
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Camping in a ruined chapel, Paloma teaches Ilsa the hedge-craft Maren taught him — including the unbinding rite that requires the caster's true name spoken aloud. Ilsa realizes he's been hiding his name even from her. Emotional beat: intimacy through teaching, and the first crack in his secrecy.

chapters.title: The Queen's Cipher
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. A courier intercepts them with a coded message from the queen: the king will be 'renewed' at the solstice, meaning fully consumed. The cipher uses Maren's notation — the hedge-witch served the crown secretly. Emotional beat: hope that they have allies, fear that Maren is already lost.

chapters.title: Doss at the Ford
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The smugglers, now serving the salt-thing unknowingly, attack at the river ford. Paloma saves Doss from drowning rather than letting him die, breaking the cycle of vengeance between them. Emotional beat: mercy as rebellion against his own bitterness.

chapters.title: Into the Weeping Wood
chapters.summary: Shared POV. They cross the Wood's threshold, where trees bleed brine and the stars are visible underground though none shine above. The forest shows each of them their worst memory made flesh. Emotional beat: vulnerability forced open; Ilsa sees Paloma's name written in his memory and says nothing.

chapters.title: The Hollow Court
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. Captured by salt-wights wearing warden armor, Ilsa is brought before the king-thing, which offers to restore her dead brother if she delivers Paloma. She refuses — barely. Emotional beat: temptation against loyalty, decided in a single breath.

chapters.title: Maren's Bargain
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Deep in the Wood, Paloma finds Maren alive but half-dissolved into salt, sustained by a bargain: her memories traded for time to finish a counter-rite. She no longer remembers him. Emotional beat: devastating reunion where love survives without recognition.

chapters.title: The True Name of the King
chapters.summary: Shared POV. Maren's fragments reveal the counter-rite needs the true king's buried name, held in the Wood's drowned heart beneath the Weeping Pool. Ilsa confesses she read Paloma's name in his memory; he forgives her. Emotional beat: honesty as the alliance's true foundation.

chapters.title: Descent Through Grief
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Paloma dives the Weeping Pool while Ilsa holds off the salt-wights above. Underwater, the drowned dead test him with every lie he's told himself about why he ran away. Emotional beat: reckoning with the identity he built to hide.

chapters.title: The King Beneath the Roots
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. At the pool's floor, Paloma finds the true king's name kept by the Wood's original guardian — a creature older than crowns, which agrees to release it only if someone willingly takes its place as keeper. Emotional beat: the terrible arithmetic of sacrifice.

chapters.title: Solstice of Salt
chapters.summary: Ilsa's POV. In the capital, the renewal ceremony begins; Ilsa breaks into the throne room as the king-thing completes its consumption. She stalls the court with the truth no one wants to hear. Emotional beat: one woman's voice against institutional blindness.

chapters.title: Unbinding
chapters.summary: Shared POV converging. Paloma arrives via the smuggler roads with the king's name; together he and Ilsa perform the unbinding before the assembled court, speaking truths aloud — including Paloma's own hidden name. The king-thing dissolves; the true king wakes weeping. Emotional beat: catharsis through public truth.

chapters.title: The Stars Return
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The stars relight over a kingdom beginning to remember itself. Maren, freed from her bargain, remembers Paloma at last — briefly, before her remaining time runs out, giving him her blessing. Emotional beat: bittersweet closure of the mentor bond.

chapters.title: The Keeper's Choice
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The Wood demands its keeper; Paloma volunteers, but Ilsa invokes the law she serves to claim the debt belongs to the crown, not one man. Instead, the guardian accepts the restored king's vow of remembrance, releasing Paloma. Emotional beat: justice achieved outside punishment, inside covenant.

chapters.title: The Salt of the Weeping Wood
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Months later, Paloma stands trial for his smuggling crimes and receives a warden's pardon contingent on service — he becomes the crown's mapmaker of the hidden roads, no longer invisible. He and Ilsa walk the border together under full stars. Emotional beat: identity chosen, loyalty earned, home redefined.
